name: Witnessing
overview: Scripture calls believers to be God's witnesses, affirming His unique deity and sovereign power as seen in Isaiah 43:10 and Matthew 28:18. Christians are commissioned to actively share the gospel, making disciples of all nations through teaching, baptizing, and preaching the good news to every creature, as commanded in Matthew 28:19 and Mark 16:15. This witness is to be lived out visibly, with good works shining before others to glorify the Father, reflecting the call in Matthew 5:16, while grounding the message in the truth of Christ’s suffering, resurrection, and fulfillment of Scripture as declared in Luke 24:46.
